capabilities: Read, search, write, and organize files, folders, and vault apps in shared vault Surfaces, with every earlier version kept.
description: Copies a vault file or artifact, any size, to toPath as a new file whose history starts at version 1 with the copied version's content; no bytes are uploaded or rewritten. toSurfaceId copies into another vault (default this one); version copies an earlier version (default the newest). An artifact's copy keeps a name ending in ".artifact", and a plain file's copy may not take one. Folders and files inside an artifact cannot be copied. Missing folders above toPath are created, and nothing may be at toPath.

path.description: The file or artifact to copy

surfaceId.description: The vault Surface's ID, from list_surfaces

toPath.description: The copy's path, including its name

toSurfaceId.description: The vault to copy into; defaults to surfaceId

name: copy_vault_file
